text:
This looks like a small side salad of spinach and mixed greens with shredded carrot and a bit of dressing, sitting on a square plate. I'm taking the plate as a side plate of about 20-22 cm. The greens cover only part of it, in a thin layer, so I estimate about 60-80 g of food. Leafy greens are around 20 kcal per 100 g, and the dressing and a few berries add some more, so I estimate about 70 kcal in total.
